subject: Sleep loss triggered a brain immune response that damaged tissue
script: From Agewell Brief: Sleep loss triggered a brain immune response that damaged tissue. New research suggests that lack of sleep might cause a harmful immune response in the brain, offering a new target for treatment. Sleep loss may trigger an automatic brain response that damages healthy tissue. The response is like a sprinkler flooding a house after a small fire. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
